Keep your platitudes. You owe me answers.
Good. I’ve taught you well. Better start gathering your forces.
I’ve seen men with their heads in a guillotine with better chances of survival than you. No offense.
I won’t stop, for Karvenia. But I think it’s time to talk.

Good. Smart. Gather some people, put swords in their hands, and take the fight to Ashbourne. Even if it’s a trap, he has no idea how many people you have on your side right now. He’s underestimating you.
Are you okay? You look like you’ve seen a ghost.
You can’t be that surprised. I mean, if he had his men kill you in the middle of the night, you become a martyr.
I know it’s tough to process. But I’m not lying.
The truth is… your father is alive. Somewhere in Karvenia.
But not before we question him. He might know about that sigil you’ve been hunting for for so long.
I’m surprised you think you have a choice. You either walk there under your own power, or you get dragged there in the night. Actually, I suppose that is a choice…
As we speak, I’ve got members of Burning Stove searching for him. You need to rest while you can, because the backlash to defeating Ashbourne won’t be far enough.
Thank you.
I promise. No more secrets or lies from now on.
Ashbourne, he wants to meet with me.
You’re no fun. Whatever, just do what feels right. Go gather your forces.
How can that be true? He hasn’t been seen since the rebellion collapsed.
Hm, I suppose so. In truth, I’ve been keeping secrets, because I didn’t know if I could trust you. I didn’t know what kind of person you had become.
And then I’ll kill him, like he deserves.
You’ve earned the right to decide Ashbourne’s fate, after what you’ve done for us.
Don’t worry, I’ve got members of Burning Stove searching for him. You need to rest while you can, because the backlash to defeating Ashbourne won’t be far enough.
Spit it out, old man. I won’t wait anymore.
As soon as possible. I just need to gather some soldiers.
But now that you’re aware of it, you know what to do. Gather some people, corner Ashbourne, and slit his throat. Fun, right?
Something wrong?
You sound just like your father. Even at the height of the rebellion, he wanted to give everyone a second chance…
We’ll speak soon, Bellwright.
And then I can capture him. The people can decide his fate.
Not to mention, your father wouldn’t want you killing a man in cold blood before any kind of trial…
I heard about what happened. Ashbourne is defeated. You’ve done a great thing, but it’s only the start.
Does that mean you’re ready to talk about my father now?
He is? Then I can’t wait a second longer, I need to find him!
Good day! I have a message for you from Lord Ashbourne!
You think I should go? I’m surprised.
Promise me you’ll tell me the second you find him.
You’re right, seems like this might be the best opportunity I have to kill him.
Ashbourne sent me a letter, asking to meet with me.
Aye, that much is clear. Now go, gather your people.
I’m not my father. I’ll do this my way.
So you think it’s a trap? He wants to kill me?
I’ve proven that I won’t be consumed by revenge. So tell me what you know about my father.
I’m not killing him unless I have to. He has to stand trial.
As soon as you’re done with Ashbourne, we’ll sit down and discuss it. Now go, gather your people.
You know that reading other people's letters is rude?
I believe it’s a classic power struggle. What we know from Burning Stove is that they hated each other from the beginning.
Sometimes it has to be done, I’m protecting Ashbourne from his own foolish decisions.
So you are telling me your methods are better than his?
Farewell.

Burning Stove spies said that Kug had been trying to make their relations better lately. Maybe he is afraid that Loxley will send an assassin after him or that Ashbourne will finally get enough of their bickering.
Fine, give me the map.
Don’t you think that working with your compatriot is better?
Besides, how did the whole meeting went?
Why does this psychopath want to meet?
I’m not gonna side with the traitor.
I’m glad you can see the reason. Here is the map.
Just a rich boy trying to be a warlord. From what I knew we were raised on some island and got some military education. He started working with Ashbourne after he was chosen as lord by the queen.
If you want my opinion, it’s a calculated risk.
Now we need the ship and its crew. Prepare well, friend.
I know how the whole conflict with Ashbourne is going. What do you think of the idea of cooperation in the future?
Burning Stove has been on his trail for a while. And their spies say he’s desperately trying to mend the division between the two.

As you may or may not notice, his new propaganda campaign has an insidious purpose, taking our fellow countrymen by deceit and selling them to the queen into slavery in exchange for some royal soldiers as reinforcements.
I was getting to it.
He caused all the chaos in Blackridgepool during the election, which led to the death of one of their candidates for Elder…
A helping hand in getting rid of this treacherous dog, Kug. His new deal with the crown is sickening, instead of relying on his own skills and men, he just went scheming under the queen's skirt.
I’m glad you didn’t act emotional there. Loxley will be useful for us in the future.
Don’t you think we are not so different, you and I?
Do you have to ask those questions at this point?
Can you explain me the conflict between Kug and Loxley?
Great idea and tell me what you will accomplish by acting like a rabid dog. Even if you survive this encounter, you will be fighting on two fronts in the future.
I want to know more about you.
Do you know who sent it?
Congratulations on building the dock. It was a great achievement for our cause. And it didn’t go unnoticed.
Even if you succeed, why burn bridges? I must admit you seem like a better leader than Ashbourne.
Kug is hiding on this island where he grew up. We were able to recover the map. If you want to hunt him there, we will not stand in your way, but you will have to get there yourself.
You can cut off the serpent’s head before it can bite you.
He’s dangerous. Allegedly, the malevolent wind, blowing in Ashbourne’s ear.
Get to the point.
Berthold Kug, master of Propaganda for Ashbourne. If you’ve seen any of those ridiculous written declarations around the Lowlands, it was his work.

Loxley thinks that this whole propaganda campaign is a joke, and they should focus on setting up puppet Elders to control people.<cf>Ashbourne is probably keeping them only because huge portions of the Brigands are backing up one or the other.
He wanted to ally with me in the future, and I refused him.
Why should I even ally with you?
Berthold Kug, master of Propaganda for Ashbourne. If you’ve seen any of those ridiculous written declarations around the Lowlands, it was his work. Quite the wordsmith, isn’t he?
Good decision, but be careful, Loxley is a clever beast, but if we play our cards right, we could gain a useful pawn.
He wants to talk about cooperation to resolve the “Kug’s issue”.
Because if you value the life of your men this is the best course of action you can take.
Who is Kug?
Are you in a hurry to raid some Ashbourne outpost? As you wish.
He is clearly plotting some backup plan in case of Ashbourne's death.
You did what?! Well, I guess he won’t stab us in the back in the future, but I hope that someone more bloodthirsty will not take his place.
And who knows, maybe there will be no fighting when Ashbourne is dead? Sometimes alliances are best tempered by fighting the common enemy.
Smart decision. We will see you in the future, hero.
Obviously, getting rid of Kug, even if his schemes are not targeting Ashbourne, he is completely incompetent and can’t be trusted.
I just finished building it. How did you know?
Deal? What deal?
The map to Kug’s island, you will go there and you will do whatever you want with him. You can capture him, kill him, it does not matter.
I’m not sure that refusing was a good idea. But it’s too late now for regrets.
Remind me who Loxley is.
It could be but also this could be an opportunity. We can leverage the conflict between those two. Just imagine we get rid of one Ashbourne right-hand man using the other.
Before we part our ways hero…
Someone has to be in charge of communication when you are missing from the village, don’t you think? You should be more concerned about who sent this message.
When you were missing, a messenger came to Haerndean and left this for you. It seems you caught the attention of someone rather important, and this person wants to meet with you.
He never had any real hardships in life, I have no idea why some Brigands chose to respect him. Maybe they were just as worthless as he is.

I was a simple boy from the farm, my family escaped the Highlands during the rebellion. Later in life, I joined a mercenary group that the Brigands absorbed. And from that point on I was climbing through the ranks to my current position.
Do you think this could be a trap?
And what will you gain from that?
Fewer casualties on both sides. What’s better, replacing one Elder or selling people into slavery and releasing the queen’s rabid dogs upon Karvenia?
I will think about it.
I want to speak with you about our cooperation.
Remind me who Kug is.
Why do you hate Kug so much?
I chose to kill him on the spot.
Isn’t it a treason from your side?
I think I will kill you here and now.
Gilroy Loxley. I believe you may have heard about him. He caused all the chaos in Blackridgepool during the election, which led to the death of one of their candidates for Elder…
Shame, but remember one who builds his throne from swords will not sit on it for long.
Now we can stop Kug’s plans before the whole situation goes out of hand. Gather your followers and prepare well, we don’t know much about this place.
Fruitful, I’ve agreed on a potential alliance in the future.
What is your offer?
Alright, I will meet with him.
What are you offering then?
But remember, we can’t let this go unchecked. The Falsgar must pay for what they have done.

Oh. I see. This is awful, on two fronts. First: this is an awful letter. I know all love letters are supposed to be this… embarrassing, but this… this is just. Honestly, I have no words to describe it.
If Isa walks into their arms, she’ll either become a prisoner or a corpse. There’s no third option.
But. You know what? I woke up in a good mood today, and I feel like you’re the right person for this job. I feel like you know all about liars and secrets.
One of our own has gone missing, Isa, the daughter of Carlos. She was last seen near her tent at dusk. No signs of a struggle, no note… just gone. Her father’s beside himself.
Fine. Wallow in self-pity.
Are you ready to go after my beloved?
I promise you.
While I admire your courage, I have to dissuade you from it. Thread carefully.
I should have known. She had been acting very strange lately. But a Cassian of all people. That deepens the wound even more.
How could you have done that? Now you tell Carlos about your little decision. I’m not the one who’s going to face him.
He’s alive? The Falsgar said they’d killed him when they took me! Take me to him!
Why is it so bad that she’s in love with a Cassian?
I can handle them alone.
Fine! But believe me, Edoardo and I are meant to be together, and we will. I won’t stop trying to get back to my love.
I should get going.
How did you and Edoardo even meet?
Now go and run to my father like a good puppy. I’m sure he’ll have some reward for you, after all, that’s all you care about. Now leave me be.
Why would she disappear? Any enemies?

Did you fall on your head and lose your senses? Cassians take what they want: our land, our resources, and now our children. Not to mention that Edoardo is too old for her. At first glance, he seems normal but I suspect that he’s even older than Carlos.
I found a letter from her beloved, Edoardo.
These are highly trained Falsgar; you can’t go alone.
You let her go with that good-for-nothing?! You’re a disgrace!
Leave me at once! I don’t want to see you ever again! Go!
So you think she left with him?
Talk to Edoardo. He’ll give you your reward.
I need you to investigate. Start by searching her camp for any clues. If this was foul play, I want to know who dared touch one of ours.
Did you find anything about my Isa?
Was there anyone suspicious around before she disappeared?
For a price, yes.
It wasn’t Jaime. It was your letter.
You can also find some people by the tavern looking for some purpose. Given that they might be slightly intoxicated.
I’ll go now.
Not the job for me.
I’ll mark everything on your map. They’re traveling down this road from Cragkeep to the port. But you have to intercept them before that. Once she reaches the port, she’ll be gone forever.
I’ll find her. Where exactly was her camp?
And secondly, this Edoardo. He’s a Cassian. A bit old to my taste, but the girl always seemed to have odd tastes.
No problem.
Isa was taken by the Falsgar. I tried to save her but I couldn’t get to her fast enough.
They will answer for their actions. I’ll make sure of it. I hope I can count on you to make that happen.
But they loved each other.
Look who decided to show their face again. Viktor told me all about that fiasco with the Alchemist, I thought I would never have the displeasure of seeing you again.
Please. Relay this information to Carlos, he would want to learn this from you.
I thought I was done for. Thank you for saving me from those brutes.
How did you know?
Every moment counts, are you finally going to find my Isa?
Say the word and I’ll be here.
The Falsgar. Oh. No. This is a tragedy. Please. Leave me. I just want my baby back. Please. Leave me be.
Isa was taken by the Falsgar. I tried to save her but I couldn’t get to her fast enough.
Your father sent me. He’s worried sick.
Why are you so confused by it?
You’re the one Lyra sent? Then you know my daughter’s gone. Did you find anything?
He was terrible at spying. Tripped over a root while watching our camp. He says he was eavesdropping on our plans, but, between you and me, I think he was watching me sleep. He does that sometimes.
He was terrible at spying. Tripped over a root while watching our camp. He says he was eavesdropping on our plans, but, between you and me, I think he was watching me sleep. He does that sometimes.

Unless you want to die nobly for the rescue of my beloved Isa, which would be very much appreciated, and I would make sure the memory of your heroic act would live on through the ages, I would suggest that you bring companions with you for this fight.
I can handle it.
Thank you for taking me back to my love.
I need a moment.
You’re back! But I don’t see my darling Isa with you. Where is she?
You could be a little more grateful that I’m saving you.
I’ll gather my people.
This won’t keep us apart! Mark my words.
I’m taking you to your father.
If you get killed, I won’t be here to save you.
Return to me when you have gathered your battalion.

But be careful. These are Falsgar men we are talking about. It wouldn’t be sensible to go after them alone. Gather your people and go after them. Or you could find some willing people near the tavern to help you.
I’ll get going.
It’s a tent nearby, you’ll know when you see it.
You see, we agreed to meet by the old lighthouse. Only she never arrived.
I know about you and Isa.
I’m ready.
We’ve had tensions with the Cassians, but… I pray this isn’t about that. Their patrols have been sniffing closer to our borders lately.
Thank you for saving our Isa. She’s safe and sound here with us.
Why risk everything for Edoardo?
Because the Cassians are no friends to the Halmayans. I fought to protect my people from their influence, and now my own daughter falls for one?
Did you finally reconsider helping find the girl?
A little reward wouldn’t hurt.
Why does him being Cassian matter?
I’ll help. Remind me what I need to do.
Wait! Remember this is a Falsgar operation.
You know? How do you know? Oh if it was that Jaime, I’m going to wring his neck. He and his big mouth.
Well, good luck with that.
You’re right, I should find someone to help.
I don’t have anymore questions.
Loved each other?! So you believe every pretty word anyone throws at you, uh? Get out of my face!
Oh gods above and bellow! You! You failed my darling Isa! You failed her! How dare you show your face to me!
I don’t have any more questions.
Fine, I’ll keep walking.
No time to lose, I need to go back to my love.

Only it wasn’t a convoy of supplies. Oh, my heart sank. I just knew that my dearest Isa had gotten caught in the Falsgar web. You have to help me! I tracked them, but I don’t have the strength to take on a group of Falsgar.
Since I don't have personal freedom anymore. Ask all you want. I’m an open book, unlike some people.
You saved her. The Cassians won’t forget this. Thank you for rescuing my little lamb. Here is your reward.
Not ready for it yet.
I’ll think about it.
If you remember what I told you, one of our own has gone missing, Isa, the daughter of Carlos.
I know. But maybe time will heal this wound. Maybe he’ll come to terms with it. Or maybe he’ll just hold a funeral for his lost daughter.
Did she have any reason to leave on her own?
Thank you! Thank you! I’m sure Edoardo with reward you well! Thank you for believing in true love.
Actually, it doesn’t matter right now. Isa is in grave danger, and if you’re so concerned with her, you’ll help me.
I couldn’t get to her on time.
Because he’s the only one who didn’t treat me like a bomb about to explode. My father saw a liability. Lyra saw a number. Edoardo? He just saw me.
Fine, I’ll do it.
You know I’m running away at the first opportunity, right?
But then, the missing people reports kept climbing. Mostly missing girls. I shudder to think those two might be connected, but it’s the only hint I have.
I waited and waited, but when I went back to camp in the early hours of the morning that I overheard Cassandra talking about a Falsgar convoy.
Leave, please. I need my space.
Oh gods! This is worse than I expected. If only she had ran off with that Cassian! The Falsgar will pay for this.
I’m busy at the moment, I’ll come back later.
But, oh, to die in the place of someone I love is a good way to go, what a sweet death.
No, nothing yet.
Are you following me?
Nothing, I was hoping you’d tell me more.
Why risk everything for Edoardo?
An envoy is leaving Cragkeep towards Cragkeep Bay soon. I need you to go after it, make sure you get to it before it reaches the bay, or it’ll be too late. Check if my Isa is with them.
It could be an inside job.
Because he’s the only one who didn’t treat me like a bomb about to explode. My father saw a liability. Lyra saw a number. Edoardo? He just saw me.
Carlos claims she’d never abandon us, but… Isa’s young. Restless. She’s been slipping out at night lately. If she ran, it wasn’t just for freedom. Someone lured her. Find out who.
My letter? How did you get your hands on it?
There was a Cassian, odd, odd-looking fellow, who kept finding reasons to linger by the guard posts. Always asking for the time, directions, anything to get near us. I thought nothing of it then.
No problem.
Between you and me? Isa’s always been… soft-hearted. If she wandered too far, she might’ve crossed paths with someone she shouldn’t have.
I can’t make promises.
Well, I don’t know much. That’s the problem. It was my job to protect her and was taken from me right under my nose.
You'd better have found something, or you’re just here to waste my time.
Please! I need your help to intercept them! Are you ready to go after the Falsgar and rescue Isa?
I’d rather a reward than work, but what is it?
Give me a moment I need someone to help me.
Find someone else to bother. I’m busy.
Actually, it was your pathetic letter that uncovered you.
I don’t know. Perhaps she thought she could run away and escape the tensions here. Or perhaps he convinced her. Cassian tongues are silver, but their hearts…their hearts are loyal only to their own.
We will prepare and plan, and I hope you will stand together with us against them when the time comes.
Yes. I found this… love letter? Take it.
Go talk with Carlos, he’ll want to know what you found. And afterwards, confront that good-for-nothing deck-rat of a Cassian.
What’s the matter?
Let’s just say I have my little ways of knowing what happens on my island.
If you’re implying one of my own men, be careful. I’d stake my life on their loyalty. But… if I’m wrong, then I’ve failed more than just her.
You think this is a ballad? That they’ll live happily ever after in some sunlit vineyard? Wake up.
She was last seen near her tent at dusk. No signs of a struggle, no note… just gone. Her father’s beside himself.
Then I can promise you that if you don’t, you’ll live to regret it.
Edoardo sent me. He wants you safe.
But you have to promise me you’ll do whatever it takes to find her… And to bring her back. Promise me!
Of course he did. Did he also tell a tale of how I was obviously manipulated because I could never have decided this on my own?
Alright, I get the message.
Lyra sent me to talk to you.
What about your father? He’ll never forgive this.
I heard you were going after some Falsgar. Thought you were going after our Isa?
I’m taking you to Edoardo.
Darek told me you’ve proved yourself useful around here, and because of that, I’m entrusting you with an important task.
I want to ask some questions.
What about your father? He’ll never forgive this.
What’s the matter?
I know. But maybe time will heal this wound. Maybe he’ll come to terms with it. Or maybe he’ll just hold a funeral for his lost daughter.
Sure, what is it?
I’ll gather some people.
Before I go. I have a few questions.
I only have one clue. There were a few reports of some Falsgar dealings. At first, it didn’t seem like anything suspicious, just cargoes and normal shipments.
How did you and Edoardo even meet?

Long ago, when King Roan still ruled, the Halamare Isles thrived as a hub of peaceful trade. Our fathers built Cragkeep from stone and secured our place as guardians of the Town, protected by the King’s alliance.

They ain’t worth my attention. I will tell you that. Hmm… I have other things to do and I have no more power to speak with these thieves. I don’t want problems with Cutlass if she finds out I was at them again…
Now I think that’s everything I wanted to ask you.
Let the blade clash.
Now they’re all here, drunk, and ready to spill blood over it.
Yes, I need you to stop fighting here in the Tavern and around its grounds.
I’m not looking for trouble, it’s my home. Halmare Isle is the home of all Halmayans, I’m just protecting what’s mine. But I understand why Mateo wants to get rid of us.
War always brings wealth to those who instrument it.
Noo, if you were one of them, you wouldn’t need an answer on that…
I’m here to ask questions.
Just wait here, and don’t do anything stupid. I will bring you the bottle.
I’m off duty! I can rest and be where the hell I want! Speaking of that, how do you feel about a little skirmish between us?
Those of us who escaped found our way back, only to find a new ruler on the throne: Queen Ossene, and her Falsgar.
Go ahead, I’m all ears.
With no problem. Consider it done.
I can't find it. Can you remind me where I should look?
Is there something interesting I should check?
Now you know. Visit me in our village, Rustshore. I will have some work for you. Farewell.

Go in the direction of a wooden bridge - not the drawbridge that is facing Cragkeep, but the other one. Search for the passage to the shore, and look for wooden floors and wrecked boats. I left my bottle inside the ropes.
When you find it, bring it to me right away, and I will leave. But be in a hurry, I don’t know if I will get bored and decide to show them where they belong.
It doesn’t matter. Can you stop the fight with people in the Tavern?
Anyway, thank you for your help. I truly appreciate it. And do visit me from time to time. I might have something for you.
Darn it, you're a cheap one, ey? Alright, what do you want to know?
Why not just throw them out?
Farewell.
What should I do with them?
Yes, I have it, now will you leave?
Then walk away. But next time you need a roof, don’t come knocking here.
Can you remind me what they did to you?
I need to admit, you’re a great piece of warrior. I guess you won’t leave now?
Just tell me where it is and I will bring it to you.
Come on, let’s go before anyone gets hurt.
If you like fishing, our waters are home to the biggest and fattest fishes that have been caught in the Kingdom.
Do you have it? Did you find it? I’m getting bored and might slice Halmayans or two.
Well, do you want to know more?
But as I said, it’s only an assumption from rumours I hear here, I’m just an innkeeper trying to get by.
No, I don't think I have time for that.
What’s their problem?
I’m not looking for trouble, it’s my home. Halmare Isle is the home of all Halmayans, I’m just protecting what’s mine. But I understand why Mateo wants to get rid of us.
I don’t want to hurt you.
I see where it’s going and I won’t fall for that.
Are you out of your mind? I see that you don’t have enough to pay me.
I don’t think I need anything at this moment.
Well, you can find him in the Cragkeep on the other side of this island. But I honestly doubt he will have time to speak with you.
Can you tell me more about this Island?
Don’t you want to go home? Relax a little? I see you’re not in good shape.
See you there.
When you find it, bring it to me right away, and I will leave. But be in a hurry, I don't know if I will get bored and decide to show them where they belong.
I’m not looking for trouble, it’s my home. Halmare Isle is the home of all Halmayans, I’m just protecting what’s mine. But I understand why Mateo wants to get rid of us.
That? Don’t tell me you didn’t try Doll’s Tears yet, that’s the biggest treasure of this whole island. It smells like donkey’s ass but tastes like the lips of young Cassians women, sweet and spicy.
I could pay you, how much do you want?
No, I don’t have time for that.
And who are you?
Not my fight.
Keep your eye on this Halmayan and Cassian, you thought that I was the reason, but just see what they are doing. The worst sort of people, poisoning our land. Good, our Queen won’t see that.
Can you stop fighting in the Tavern?
That makes sense why you are all hostile to each other. I didn’t know about this.
No practice weapons, only blade and steel. Me against you. If you win, I will go away and leave these two alone. What do you say?
Till the next one, adventurer.
So, will you bring me my special bottle from my hidden stash? I promise then I will leave this place.
So, no spilling blood, I guess? And my excitement is gone. I will take care of them.
Let me see.
I hope not.
You don’t know Cassian's leader? You’re really new to this area, aren't you? The Cutlass is our true ruler of these seas and this land!
I only hope they don’t return with lit torches to burn the port to the ground. Or the worst would be Berthold Kug riding in and taking my tavern by force.
A deal is a deal, here have something for your trouble, buy yourself something to drink and lighten up.
Ouch! You hit me hard, you could’ve killed me!
WHAT?
Asking nicely won’t work?
Now they’re all here, drunk, and ready to spill blood over it. And I don’t want to have a dead body found in this port.
Guard? Haha, shouldn’t you be actually protecting the town instead of getting wasted to death?
Ey! Keep some respect for the Guard of Cragkeep! I can cut your guts with no effort, the same like these two, vagabonds. Walking around with weapons, asking for trouble. And I will keep my town safe!
They call me Bellwright, you must have heard of me.
Do you want to ask anything else?
If that will make you go away, then let’s do it.
Got it.

I want to keep my Tavern quiet and far away from Viceroy's attention. But there are three bastards that will ruin everything. I saw them pretty close to start a serious fight and I don’t want dead bodies on my grounds. Can you do something with them?
I'll tell you what. Bring me my special bottle from my hidden stash, and I will leave.
Farwell… see you in Cragkeep.
Now, we are strangers in our own homeland—unwelcome, forgotten, and cast aside…
Anything else?
Halmare Island is eaten by slavery, smugglers, and battles between factions living here. That has been happening for as long as I can remember.
You think I haven’t tried? If I drag out one, the other two will burn this place down just to prove a point.
No, I won't be fighting with some drunk old man.
When I spoke with Cassian and Halmayan, it seemed that there’s a great fight going on. Shouldn't Viceroy and Falsgars do something about it?
Our Island is rich in rare resources, we have the finest wine in the whole Kingdom. Slavery is a big pain in the ass but people know how to avoid smugglers.

Effective military command relies on organizing your followers into specialized Squads. This structure allows you to issue distinct orders to different Squads, such as positioning archers on high ground while your melee frontline holds a choke point. Within the Squad Settings, you have granular control over combat behavior, including the specific quantity of healing supplies each member should carry and the health threshold at which they will stop to use them—provided their gear preset allows for it.<cf><cf>In the field, you can issue real-time commands to individual Squads or your entire army to follow, move to specific location, stop, hold position, or initiate a full charge. To manage engagements, you can toggle between having a Squad attack any enemy on sight or remain steady, holding their ground until the enemy closes the distance before engaging.<cf><cf>You have the flexibility to raise and dismiss Squads separately, and the same followers can be assigned to multiple Squads as reservists. This allows you to deploy small Squads for minor tasks or call upon your entire force for major campaigns. Upon being Dismissed, members immediately return to their duties as workers, remaining ready to re-equip the moment their Squad is called back to arms.

Gear presets automate what your villagers wear and eat, removing the need for individual management. Each settler has two slots: one for their Worker role and one for their Companion/Guard role. This ensures they automatically switch between productivity-focused clothing and combat-ready armor when their role changes. For companions, it requires the contextual command Stock Up while pointing at a Staging Ground.<cf><cf>Full control over these presets is unlocked once you construct a Staging Ground. While default presets cannot be modified directly, they can be duplicated and then edited as custom presets. Settlers will only equip gear that meets their specific skill requirements based on these rules. <cf><cf>You can set priorities for specific items or entire categories. Specific items are always checked first; even at the same priority level, a specific item takes precedence over a general category. When a category is prioritized, settlers automatically pick the best gear from shared storage based on stats: the highest damage for weapons, highest protection for armor, and highest health bonus for food.

Hunger also lowers morale, further reducing overall efficiency.<cf><cf>By default, all villagers and companions attempt to fill all three of their food slots. If a companion has a Food Bag, they will also try to keep its internal slots full. Within squad settings, the food slider only determines if they should carry additional food beyond these standard slots.<cf><cf>Settlers and guards automatically eat from shared storage when hungry. Companions, however, require management: with a Staging Ground, you can use the "Stock Up" command to have them gather food based on their Gear preset. Managing your settlers is essential for maintaining a functional and self-sustaining settlement. You cannot directly assign a villager to a specific workstation; instead, you manage their workflow by setting priorities for different job categories.<cf><cf>Priority levels range from 1 to 9, where 1 is the highest priority. A settler will always look for work starting at their highest-priority category. They will only move down to lower-ranked tasks if no work is available for their top priorities. For example, if a settler has Farming set to a higher priority than other jobs, they will always prioritize farming as long as there is a corresponding structure with pending work, and the required tools or resources are available.<cf><cf>Every task a settler performs is tied to a specific structure. When a settler looks for work within a prioritized category, they check all corresponding structures in that category and will choose the one with the highest structure priority first. If multiple structures have the same priority level, the settler will pick the one closest to their current location. To ensure maximum efficiency, you can balance these priorities with a settler's skill levels, as those with higher skills in a specific field will produce faster and more effectively.
